Off the Rails#765.dst: Quê? Não! Não pode ter sido ela!
Off the Rails#765.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#766.src: Uh... Yeah, I don' see how it could've been her, bud.
Off the Rails#766.dst: Hã... É, não vejo como pode ter sido ela, chapa.
Off the Rails#766.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#767.src: Do we care? We were going to arrest our detective here without evidence, anyway, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.dst: E daí? A gente ia prender nosso detetive aqui sem provas mesmo, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#768.src: I guess yer right, though it might be hard to spin an Aelumian as guilty... They're pretty well-behaved.
Off the Rails#768.dst: Acho que cê tá certo, mas pode ser difícil pintar uma aelumiana como culpada... São bem comportados.
Off the Rails#768.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#769.src: ...This is ridiculous! You can't do this!
Off the Rails#769.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#770.src: Must I repeat myself? Do ya want to be put down as an accomplice? Quiet, you.
Off the Rails#770.dst: Vou ter que repetir? Quer ser fichado como cúmplice? Quieto, você.
Off the Rails#770.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#771.src: Hey, Maury... What if we arrested HIM instead. It'd be easier to explain, no?
Off the Rails#771.dst: Ei, Maury... E se a gente prendesse ELE? Mais fácil de explicar, não?
Off the Rails#771.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#773.src: ...you know what? Yes. Take me instead.
Off the Rails#773.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#775.src: Hands behind yer back, bub, the train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#775.dst: Mãos pra trás, chapa, o trem tá chegando em {p}.
Off the Rails#775.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#776.src: Come on, idiot. We're not going to let you accuse US, obviously.
Off the Rails#776.dst: Qual é, idiota. É claro que não vamo deixar cê acusar A GENTE.
Off the Rails#776.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#777.src: Even if it WAS me, there'd be nothing ya could do about it. We're the ones with power here. Now go and select one of the passengers, come on.
Off the Rails#777.dst: Mesmo que FOSSE eu, cê não podia fazer nada. Quem manda aqui somos nós. Agora vai e escolhe um dos passageiros, anda.
Off the Rails#777.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#778.src: ...You mean to suggest she... No, that's just not possible.
Off the Rails#778.dst: ...Está sugerindo que ela... Não, isso é impossível.
Off the Rails#778.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#779.src: Yeah, why would she? She had important business to do...
Off the Rails#779.dst: É, por que ela faria isso? Tinha negócios importantes...
Off the Rails#779.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#780.src: Well, Harvin, maybe she got tired of her job? That Majin bossin' her around all the time's gotta get tirin'...
Off the Rails#780.dst: Bom, Harvin, e se ela cansou do trampo? O Majin mandando nela o tempo todo deve cansar...
Off the Rails#780.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#782.src: You know what? Even if she did do it, I don't care; we need someone to blame. Now COME ON! Accuse someone already, preferably alive this time!
Off the Rails#782.dst: Quer saber? Mesmo que ela tenha feito, não ligo; precisamos de um culpado. Agora ANDA! Acusa alguém logo, de preferência vivo desta vez!
Off the Rails#782.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#784.src: That guy we just arrested? He was STACKED! LOADED! We're gonna be vacationing in the {p} with this kind of money, haha!
Off the Rails#784.dst: Aquele cara que a gente prendeu? Tava CHEIO DA GRANA! RICAÇO! Vamo tirar férias em {p} com esse dinheiro, haha!
Off the Rails#784.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#785.src: Don't tell Maury, but I felt like you deserved a small cut of the profits. Y'know, for figuring it out, and all.
Off the Rails#785.dst: Não conta pro Maury, mas achei que cê merecia uma parte do lucro. Sabe, por ter resolvido e tal.
Off the Rails#785.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#786.src: HEY! HARVIN! Didn't I tell ya not to go and give 'em anything? Idiot!
Off the Rails#786.dst: EI! HARVIN! Não falei pra não dar nada pra ele? Idiota!
Off the Rails#786.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#787.src: ...Shoot. Guess that's my cue to leave.
Off the Rails#787.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#788.src: Got a ticket or train pass?
Off the Rails#788.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#789.src: ...A General's train pass??? But... But you're not-
Off the Rails#789.dst: ...Um passe de General??? Mas... Mas você não é-
Off the Rails#789.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#790.src: Okay, okay... Sorry for questioning you, General. Where would you like to go today?
Off the Rails#790.dst: Tá, tá... Desculpe duvidar, General. Para onde deseja ir hoje?
Off the Rails#790.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#791.src: Looks like someone dropped their train ticket... You're sure they wouldn't mind if you kept it.
Off the Rails#791.dst: Parece que alguém deixou cair o bilhete de trem... Ninguém vai ligar se você ficar com ele.

Off the Rails#792.src: It's for a train to {p}! Might be worth checking out.
Off the Rails#792.dst: É um bilhete de trem para {p}! Vale a pena conferir.

Off the Rails#793.src: You should talk to the Ticket Collector first.

Off the Rails#794.src:
Businessman
I-I swear I had it right here...
Off the Rails#794.dst:
Businessman
E-eu juro que estava bem aqui...
Off the Rails#794.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#796.src: You might as well look around while you wait for the train to arrive.
Off the Rails#796.dst: Aproveite para dar uma olhada enquanto espera o trem chegar.

Off the Rails#797.src: Alternatively, you could find somewhere to sit to pass the time.
Off the Rails#797.dst: Ou então ache um lugar para sentar e passar o tempo.

Off the Rails#798.src: You can check how long is left at the top of the screen.
Off the Rails#798.dst: Veja quanto falta no topo da tela.

Off the Rails#799.src: You have a ticket, so don't you know the price? Ah, whatever- it's like, {~} Liquid Emeralds. That's a LOT.
Off the Rails#799.dst: Se tem bilhete, não sabe o preço? Ah, tanto faz: é, tipo, {~} esmeraldas líquidas. É MUITO.
Off the Rails#799.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#800.src: Saving up's been a real nightmare, I tell ya. What with the price of rent and food, it's hard to hold onto any money at all!
Off the Rails#800.dst: Juntar dinheiro foi um pesadelo, vou te contar. Com o preço do aluguel e da comida, é difícil guardar qualquer dinheiro!
Off the Rails#800.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#801.src: In order to afford this trip, I've been working overtime every day for the past year, and even eating less just to save on food.
Off the Rails#801.dst: Para bancar esta viagem, fiz hora extra todo dia no último ano, e até comi menos para economizar.
Off the Rails#801.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#802.src: I'm glad the nightmare's finally over, though. Once I'm back from this trip, I'm never doing anything like that again!
Off the Rails#802.dst: Mas que bom que o pesadelo enfim acabou. Quando voltar desta viagem, nunca mais faço algo assim!
Off the Rails#802.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#803.src: My job? I work at a tool factory up in the north, we make stuff like nice cutlery for export to the other regions.
Off the Rails#803.dst: Meu trabalho? Numa fábrica de ferramentas no norte; fazemos coisas como talheres finos para exportar.
Off the Rails#803.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#804.src: Really, I don't get why we can't keep some for ourselves... We're the ones who put in all the work, why do THEY get rewarded for- Agh, whatever.
Off the Rails#804.dst: Sério, não entendo por que não podemos ficar com alguns... Somos nós que fazemos todo o trabalho, por que ELES ganham por- Argh, tanto faz.
Off the Rails#804.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#805.src: ...Anyway. My factory's let us all take a week off. Usually we only get a day off at this time of year, since the Festival's in town, but...
Off the Rails#805.dst: ...Enfim. A fábrica deu uma semana de folga para todos. Em geral só ganhamos um dia nesta época, por causa do Festival, mas...
Off the Rails#805.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#806.src: It turns out the old steelworks next to the station most of us use to commute to work had a slag beetle infestation, so said station had to be closed. Nasty critters, them, they destroy metals.
Off the Rails#806.dst: Acontece que a velha siderúrgica ao lado da estação que quase todos usamos para ir ao trabalho teve uma praga de besouros-de-escória, e a estação fechou. Bichos nojentos, destroem metal.
Off the Rails#806.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#807.src: Ended up working out for me, though- it's the perfect time for me to finally put my holiday plans into action!
Off the Rails#807.dst: Mas acabou sendo bom para mim: é a hora perfeita de finalmente pôr meus planos de férias em prática!
Off the Rails#807.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#808.src: Yeah... Working overtime every day does that to ya...
Off the Rails#808.dst: É... Fazer hora extra todo dia dá nisso...
Off the Rails#808.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#809.src: I've also been expending a lot of energy preparing for my trip... Yawn...
Off the Rails#809.dst: Também gastei muita energia preparando a viagem... Bocejo...
Off the Rails#809.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#810.src: Say... I could go for an energy drink. There's a vending machine in this station. Wanna come?
Off the Rails#810.dst: Olha... Bem que eu tomaria um energético. Tem uma máquina de venda nesta estação. Vem?
Off the Rails#810.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#812.src:
Malic
Yeesh.... Do they ever clean this place?
Off the Rails#812.dst:
Malic
Eca.... Será que nunca limpam este lugar?
Off the Rails#812.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#813.src: You hear about that new Majin PEACOCK POWER stuff they're selling in these?
Off the Rails#813.dst: Soube desse novo PEACOCK POWER do Majin que vendem nestas máquinas?
Off the Rails#813.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#814.src: Me personally? I'm sticking to Zhirao Sleep. PEACOCK POWER is too... flavorful for my tastes.
Off the Rails#814.dst: Eu? Fico no Zhirao Sleep. PEACOCK POWER tem... sabor demais para meu gosto.
Off the Rails#814.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#815.src: ...On top of that, I... Honestly, just don't really like Highlanders.
Off the Rails#815.dst: ...E também... Sinceramente, não gosto muito dos das Terras Altas.
Off the Rails#815.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#816.src: ...I mean, seriously! Every time one of them visits the Roughworks, they're always so... inconsiderate. They act like we live in filth... Like they're somehow better than us...
Off the Rails#816.dst: ...Quer dizer, sério! Toda vez que um deles visita Roughworks, é tão... sem consideração. Agem como se vivêssemos na imundície... Como se fossem melhores que a gente...
Off the Rails#816.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#817.src: And Majin is the embodiment of that. I mean, he is the Sovereign of the {p}, so, y'know... His drink doesn't really appeal to me.
Off the Rails#817.dst: E o Majin é a encarnação disso. Quer dizer, ele é o Soberano de {p}, então, sabe... A bebida dele não me atrai.
Off the Rails#817.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#818.src: Oh, yeah. It's ridiculously expensive, too.
Off the Rails#818.dst: Ah, é. E é absurdamente cara.
Off the Rails#818.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#819.src: I have high expectations for {p}. I've heard it's beautiful over there- a couple of my buddies are lucky enough to work at the Auburn Lumbermill.
Off the Rails#819.dst: Tenho grandes expectativas para {p}. Dizem que lá é lindo; dois amigos meus têm a sorte de trabalhar na Serraria de Auburn.
Off the Rails#819.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#820.src: I've never seen what it looks like, personally. The Wall of Xima has made sure of that. But apparently they've got beautiful trees there, trees with golden leaves...
Off the Rails#820.dst: Nunca vi como é, pessoalmente. A Muralha de Xima garantiu isso. Mas parece que lá tem árvores lindas, árvores de folhas douradas...
Off the Rails#820.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#821.src: Sadly, I'm just slightly too late to get to see what the Queen's Festival there is like. I can't imagine it's much different to ours, though.
Off the Rails#821.dst: Pena que cheguei um pouco tarde para ver o Festival da Rainha de lá. Mas não imagino que seja muito diferente do nosso.
Off the Rails#821.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#822.src: I bet the people there are lovely, too, just based on what I've seen from their Sovereign. Although, he is apparently a Highlander... Still! Can't be worse than our bunch.
